releaseNotes.headline: Real logos, and Grok Build stays signed in
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.9 shows the official Claude, Cursor, and Grok Build marks, keeps Grok Build's sign-in fresh, and explains API-key Claude Code setups.

highlights.title: The official marks
highlights.detail: Claude, Cursor, and Grok Build rows now use the vendors’ own logos, tinted to match the rail in light and dark mode.

highlights.title: Grok Build keeps working
highlights.detail: When Grok Build’s six-hour sign-in expires, usAIge asks the Grok CLI to renew it instead of dropping the row.

highlights.title: Clearer Claude status
highlights.detail: If Claude Code bills an API key through a helper, Manage AI Tools says there are no plan limits to show and how to sign in with a plan.
